turns.query: What goal difference did Liverpool end the 2024-2025 Premier League season with?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_goal_difference FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2024-2025' AND tss_team = 'Liverpool';
